title: Chapter 116: Continue The Counterattack
content:
Chapter 116: Continue The Counterattack

The ghouls maintained a strong offensive for nearly an hour. With the help of Weird, they opened up another battlefield in another direction of the Zerg underground base in the same way.

The Zerg saw through the ghouls' plot without the patrol of the one-star host, and continued to accumulate strength, and survived the first wave of fierce attacks of the ghouls in the same way.

Because the Zerg had defensive buildings and a large number of Hydralisks as the backbone output force, the ghouls' manpower consumption was far greater than that of the Zerg puppies. The two sides fought until midnight, and the number of Zerg puppies lost had exceeded 100,000!

It is conceivable how terrifying the number of ghouls is!

If the system does not recycle the corpses of both sides, the ghouls can bury the Zerg underground base with just the corpses!

This is a terrible war of attrition!

Seeing that the number of ghouls has not decreased significantly, Wu Qing is a little curious about what the ghouls rely on to breed such a large number?

And what kind of method, in this underground world, can such a large force be invested in the Zerg underground territory in such a short time?

What is the limit of the ghouls?

What role does weirdness play in this?

Wu Qing didn't know these things. The world at night is weird, and the Zerg dare not step out of the territory at night.

After midnight, the offensive of the ghouls on the two huge battlefields finally weakened. In other directions of the Zerg underground base, no more ghouls were found to be secretly moving.

This made the Zerg base, which has been in a high-speed operation state, breathe a sigh of relief.

The ghouls seemed to have discovered that this extreme high-intensity attack could not defeat the Zerg at once. The Zerg is stronger than imagined!

However, the ghouls did not give up. They chose to maintain an offensive at a lower intensity level and continue to attack the Zerg base, as if they were not worried about the number of ghouls at all.

The Zerg also chose to reduce the number of Zerg Zerg Zerglings and appropriately increased the number of Zerg Hydralisks. While reducing their own manpower losses, they kept the offensive on the battlefield in a wonderful balance.

If they can choose, Wu Qing hopes that the two sides can continue to fight like this. The behavior of the ghouls is to send resources to the Zerg!

Ideals are full, but reality is cruel. This world must follow the law of conservation of matter and energy, and ghouls do not appear out of thin air.

When the ghouls' forces were exhausted to a limit and they saw that it was hopeless to capture the Zerg's underground base, the ghoul army finally chose to retreat.

After the ghoul army slowly retreated, it left behind two huge underground spaces and countless large and small passages.

These ready-made underground spaces saved a lot of time for the Zerg to expand their underground bases.

Until now, Wu Qing still didn't know how those weird things made so much earth and stone disappear in a short time.

If you can't figure it out, don't think about it. Wu Qing transferred worker bees to build colonies along the edge of the Zerg territory, evolving them into defensive buildings, allowing the Zerg's fungal blanket to quickly spread to two new spaces and incorporate these places into the Zerg territory.

After these places were transformed into Zerg territories, worker bees were sent to clean and reinforce them, and build underground base spaces that met the Zerg's requirements.

The mother nest in the Zerg territory continued to grow soldiers. Wu Qing had to restore the number of puppies to 100,000 by dawn, increase the number of hydralisks to 10,000, and increase the number of worker bees to 5,000.

Seeing the terrifying digging ability of the ghouls and the weird, Wu Qing felt that the Zerg was still somewhat lacking in this aspect. If he wanted to manage the underground base well, the number of worker bees could not be too small.

That night, the Zerg spent time guarding against the ghouls' raids again. By the way, they renovated and expanded the entire Zerg underground base, added a lot of Zerg buildings, and made good use of the space dug out by the ghouls and the weird.

By dawn, the Zerg's soldiers had recovered, but Wu Qing continued to let the mother nest send troops. After he was sure that the weirdness of the underground world had disappeared, he immediately mobilized the Zerg army. He wanted to continue to attack the ghouls and find the real ghoul nest!

After last night's heavy consumption, the ghouls would definitely be affected to a certain extent. They immediately counterattacked at dawn because they didn't want to give them too much recovery time.

The current situation is equivalent to the Zerg in the light and the ghouls in the dark, and the Zerg base camp is exposed under the eyes of the ghouls.

Moreover, the ghouls are very intelligent and good at learning. Maybe they will come up with new tricks tonight. If the Zerg don't deal with it well, they may capsize.

In order to prevent such a thing from happening, Wu Qing must have a clear understanding of the surrounding ghouls and try to keep the enemy out.

Although Wu Qing likes the resources delivered by the ghouls, the risk faced by the Zerg base in the battle last night is also very high. It has been confirmed that the ghouls with weird support cannot be measured in a conventional way.

A large number of Zerg troops have gathered in the Zerg underground base. The Zerg puppies serving as pioneers have rushed to the passages left by the ghouls after retreating last night. They want to conduct a comprehensive detection of all the existing passages.

Wu Qing saw the huge passages left by a large number of ghouls through the perspective of the Zerg.

These giant passages should have been dug out by the weird last night to support the ghouls to quickly transport troops.

For some unknown reason, these passages have been preserved intact, making it convenient for the Zerg to send out troops.

After exploring all the passages, although these passages seem to be connected in all directions, they actually all lead to the underground cave yesterday.

After the battle in the underground cave yesterday, Wu Qing has figured out that it is just a garrison cave for ghouls, not the mysterious and unknown ghoul nest.

The Zerg puppies quietly went to the cave to scout the situation, and were discovered by the lurking ghouls as soon as they approached.

Wu Qing did not hold back this time, and invested 50,000 puppies and all 10,000 hydralisks in the first batch, of which nearly 100 hydralisks upgraded to one star.

The Zerg army used the ready-made passages to quickly rush to the underground cave where the ghouls gathered.

The ghouls discovered the Zerg army and sent troops to intercept them. The two sides repeated the battle process of yesterday's daytime, but this time there were more passages, taller and more spacious, so the battle between the two sides was more intense.

But after the battle of that level last night, this small scene now is not even a warm-up battle.

The Zerg army successfully rushed out of the passages distributed in different locations in the cave, and at the same time launched an attack on the ghouls in the cave.

Wu Qing did not charge into battle again this time, but just followed the Zerg army to observe the various situations of the ghouls at close range.

The ghouls in the daytime did not seem to be as active as at night. The momentum of the ghouls fighting against the Zerg now was completely incomparable to last night, and even their strength seemed to have weakened a lot.

Without comparison, this difference could not be discovered for a while.

"Things related to weirdness are indeed nocturnal species."

Knowing this, try to choose to fight ghouls during the day in the future, which will take a lot of advantages.
